body:
Following @Haroenv suggestions on my PR (thanks for your support), I've moved the fixes to the `searchkit` adapter: https://github.com/searchkit/searchkit/pull/1412.

After doing the changes, I must confess they feel more simple in there, which is always a good thing.

I am afraid that repo is not that well maintained as this one, so it may take time for the changes to be merged, but in the meantime I've used https://github.com/ds300/patch-package to patch the changes on my projects. They are working fine so far!

Sadly, I won't be able to do the same for the `typesense` adapter, I don't have the time and knowledge to build a demo project and try it for myself.
